description.value:
You imbue your armor with a fragment of your own will, causing the outer plating to fly off you and assist in the fight of its own accord. You summon an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.alien-core-bestiary.Actor.Animated Tech Armor] to fight for you. The animated tech armor can use any abilities of the armor as if it were Activated and worn by it.

Heightened (5th) The summoned armor has the aerial and elite adjustments.

system.requirements: You're wearing armor with the tech trait, used as a locus.
